translator_notes: Humorous complaint about a sickly wife. 'злото ме нападна' I read as 'trouble attacked me'; 'на рака лежало' as she has been lying on his arm, my reading.

words_to_learn.en: it fell to me, I got (by lot)

lines.en: I was a bachelor, mother, a bachelor,

lines.cyr: ерген одев мајко, поарно ми беше.
lines.lat: ergen odev majko, poarno mi beše.
lines.en: I was a bachelor, mother, it was better for me.
I got married, mother, I got married,

lines.cyr: се оженив мајко, злото ме нападна.
lines.lat: se oženiv majko, zloto me napadna.
lines.en: I got married, mother, and trouble fell upon me.

lines.cyr: падна ми се мамо, либе болничаво.
lines.lat: padna mi se mamo, libe bolničavo.
lines.en: I got, mama, a sickly wife.

lines.lat: sanoḱ mi e majko, na raka ležalo.
lines.en: all night, mother, she has lain on my arm.

lines.cyr: Па не можам мајко, па не можам
lines.lat: Pa ne možam majko, pa ne možam
lines.en: So I can't, mother, so I can't,

they lifted me, mother, my comrades.
